nodeCam_togglePicker.title: nodeCam: toggle node picker
nodeCam_togglePicker.desc: Show nearby nodes and the crosshair, so you can pick what the camera welds to
nodeCam_togglePicker.onDown: if not nodeCamCore then extensions.load('nodeCamCore') end if nodeCamCore then nodeCamCore.togglePicker() end

nodeCam_toggleNode.title: nodeCam: toggle node under crosshair
nodeCam_toggleNode.desc: Add or remove the node you are aiming at. Needs the picker on
nodeCam_toggleNode.onDown: if not nodeCamCore then extensions.load('nodeCamCore') end if nodeCamCore then nodeCamCore.toggleNode() end

nodeCam_clearNodes.title: nodeCam: clear nodes (steady view)
nodeCam_clearNodes.desc: Drop every attached node and go back to a steady view on the vehicle axes
nodeCam_clearNodes.onDown: if not nodeCamCore then extensions.load('nodeCamCore') end if nodeCamCore then nodeCamCore.clearNodes() end

nodeCam_cycleSlot.title: nodeCam: next camera slot
nodeCam_cycleSlot.desc: Cycle the saved cameras for this vehicle
nodeCam_cycleSlot.onDown: if not nodeCamCore then extensions.load('nodeCamCore') end if nodeCamCore then nodeCamCore.cycleSlot() end

nodeCam_toggleEnabled.title: nodeCam: toggle node following
nodeCam_toggleEnabled.desc: Switch between following the picked nodes and a steady view on the vehicle axes
nodeCam_toggleEnabled.onDown: if not nodeCamCore then extensions.load('nodeCamCore') end if nodeCamCore then nodeCamCore.toggleEnabled() end
